assessment.summary: This study evaluated DDT resistance and resistance mechanisms in field-collected Anopheles pharoensis from three sites (Maga, Simatou, Yangah) in northern Cameroon. Sanger sequencing of the VGSC gene covering L1014F/S in 114 DDT-resistant mosquitoes detected no kdr mutations (100% wild type), indicating resistance is associated with cuticular hydrocarbon thickening rather than kdr target-site mutations.
